title: Emrys and the Inventory
author: Xanthe Villalobos
blurb: Bram Eastwick, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
